title: How we know it is right
lead: Every number on this page is read from the committed validation file. Nothing here is typed by hand.
exampleBanner: This is the example file. The measured values are still empty, so the tables show the shape of the check, not its result.

holdout.heading: Hold-out results
holdout.caption: The conversion is fitted on some years and scored on years it never saw.
holdout.chosenBy: How the method was chosen: two countries, scored in detail, with the conversion fitted on those two alone.

slices.heading: Results by group
slices.caption: A weak group cannot hide inside an average, so each group is scored on its own.
slices.none: No group results in the file yet.

agreement.heading: Two satellites on the same thing
agreement.caption: Where two sensors overlap, they should see about the same.
agreement.none: No satellite comparison in the file yet.

ratios.heading: Our ratio next to a published one
ratios.caption: Where somebody has published a figure, ours is put beside it.
ratios.none: No published comparison in the file yet.

coverage.heading: Does the range hold
coverage.caption: A range stated as 90 per cent should really hold about 90 per cent of the values.
coverage.none: No range check in the file yet.

chance.heading: Chance of fire, checked
chance.caption: Each bin holds the months we gave a similar chance, next to how often fire actually followed.
chance.none: No reliability bins in the file yet.

controls.heading: Control totals
controls.caption: Checks that a total did not change along the way.
controls.none: No control totals in the file yet.

limits.heading: What this data cannot do
limits.none: No limits listed in the file yet.

scopeCountryMonthJoint: one country, one month, joint range
scopeCellMonthFine: one finer 0.1 degree square, one month
scopeCircleMonthWeighted: one 50 km circle, one month, cells weighted by overlap

world.heading: The model the app uses, on every country
world.spreadCaption: How the error is spread across countries, overall and by how much each country burns.
